units: <cite ref="Berakhot 7a:16">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>קאי אחד כ׳</he> stands on one leg.
<cite ref="Menachot 34a">Men. 34ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 11b:9">Yoma 11ᵇ</cite> <he>כי עקר איניש כַּרְעֵיה וכ׳</he> when a person starts to walk, he moves his right leg first.
<cite ref="Yoma 78a:5">Ib. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה כאיב לי כַּרְעָאִי</he> my leg was hurting me.
<cite ref="Yoma 78a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>גבא דכ׳ הוה</he> I mean the upper portion of the leg.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49a:5">Kidd. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מסאנא דרב מכַּרְעָאִי וכ׳</he> I want no shoe larger than my foot, i.e. I want no husband too high in rank.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:4">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>כַּרְעֵיה דגימ״ל</he>, <he>דדל״ת</he> the foot of the letter Gimmel, … Daleth; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="K01287"><he>כְּרָעַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>כַּרְעִין</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 1:13">Targ. O. Lev. I, 13</cite> (Y. <he>ריגלי</he>). Ib. 9 <he>כְּרָעוֹהִי</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 3:12">Targ. Am. III, 12</cite>; a. e.—Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ bot. <he>חמון כ׳</he> look at these legs (how fat); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:9">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:7">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665:8">Yalk. ib. 665</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:13:1">Koh. R. to V, 13</cite>.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:9">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>עד טופרי דכְרָעַיְיהוּ</he> to the nails of their feet; a. fr.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, end, 55ᶜ <he>כּוּרְעָתָא דערסא</he> legs of the bed.
